g.text: One endpoint-conditioned record (800 people who appear in at least one of 6,418 friendships), 32 overlapping 50-node draws. Smaller = closer on
that metric only; panels have different units and are not combined. Ticks are model or bank spread, not confidence intervals.
One model (LLM rows) or one simulation bank
Mean of four models / eight banks
Target-informed diagnostic, not a transfer competitor
